content: Only MNB with tfBOW performed better than MSM. This result may be because tfBOW features encode the word frequencies, while MSM only considers a single occurrence of words. When incorporating the word frequencies with our TF weighted word subspace, we achieved a higher accuracy of 92.01%, performing better than MNB at a significance level of 95%.
